slides.title: Ethiopian official defends media restrictions
slides.body: Ambassador Redwan Hussein: outlets must follow the law.

slides.title: No outlet is above the law
slides.body: He said money, owners or foreign ties give no immunity, per Borkena.

slides.title: Warnings before action
slides.body: He said some outlets were advised up to 15 times before enforcement.

slides.title: Rights group disagrees
slides.body: Human Rights Watch calls the indefinite ban on The Reporter part of a civic-space crackdown.

slides.title: Press freedom and open dialogue
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
